constraints.message: SharedSurfaceDeclaration: owner_agent_id MUST appear in writer_agent_ids. The owner of a shared surface is one of its declared writers.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by the registered cross-field validator validateSharedSurfaceDeclaration; the DSL expression uses the LOCAL array_contains builtin (v8.8.0). Exact string membership; agent identifiers are not normalised (non-constraint SSD-N4). The owner is NOT required to appear in reader_agent_ids (non-constraint SSD-N3).

constraints.message: SharedSurfaceDeclaration: when single_writer is true, writer_agent_ids MUST have exactly one entry. Together with SSD-1 that entry is the owner.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by the registered cross-field validator. A multi-writer surface may declare a single writer (single_writer false with one entry is admitted): the flag is a promise that the list will stay at one, not a description of the current count.

constraints.message: SharedSurfaceDeclaration: writer_agent_ids MUST NOT contain duplicate entries.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by the registered cross-field validator, which reports each duplicated value with the indices where it occurs. The DSL expression uses the LOCAL array_values_distinct builtin (v8.8.0); unique_values applies to arrays of objects keyed by a field and is vacuously true on arrays of strings, so it cannot express this rule. Cross-language runners implement it as a set-size comparison. Duplicates are rejected rather than tolerated because SSD-6 runtime conformance checks compare observed writers against this list as a set.

constraints.message: SharedSurfaceDeclaration: reader_agent_ids MUST NOT contain duplicate entries. An empty reader list is admitted.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by the registered cross-field validator. Same array_values_distinct builtin as SSD-3. No relationship between readers and writers is required (non-constraints SSD-N2 and SSD-N3).

constraints.expression: consumer verifies that locator is unique across every SharedSurfaceDeclaration in its registry
constraints.message: SharedSurfaceDeclaration: locator MUST be unique across the consumer's declarations. The library cannot see other declarations.
constraints.evaluation_note: Cross-record consumer state per ADR-010. The library does not parse locator (non-constraint SSD-N1), so equivalence between two spellings of one surface is also the consumer's to decide. A consumer registry that admits a second declaration for an existing locator has two owners for one surface, which is the ambiguity this schema exists to remove.

constraints.expression: consumer verifies at runtime that every agent observed writing to the surface appears in writer_agent_ids
constraints.message: SharedSurfaceDeclaration: every runtime writer MUST be a declared writer. An undeclared writer is the incident class this declaration exists to detect: a cache that became a message board.
constraints.evaluation_note: Runtime observation per ADR-010: the library sees the declaration, not the writes. Consumers compare the set of agents in the surface's write log (or the audit trail named by audit_trail_id, when present) against writer_agent_ids and treat any agent outside the list as a violation. When single_writer is true the comparison reduces to every write coming from owner_agent_id.
